Class AmwpFacade.ProbeGate

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpFacade.ProbeGate
Enclosing class:
AmwpFacade
private final class AmwpFacade.ProbeGate extends Object
The ProbeGate class runs one Grok probe for this server process. The valid flag matches the key that passed. The flag is not written to a file. The shell does not keep a copy. A restart clears it. The probe future stays here. Cancelling the leader does not cancel it.

  • Method Details

    • admit

      AmwpFacade.ProbeOutcome admit(String model, String effort, boolean sendEffort)
      The admit method checks the probe and claims the leader under the lock. The lock is released before LlmRouter.startGrokProbe(String, String, boolean). The region lock is not held. The probe does not pin that user's region. An empty model returns AmwpFacade.ProbeOutcome.FAIL and no model defined. An empty key returns AmwpFacade.ProbeOutcome.FAIL and grok key missing. A valid flag for the same key returns AmwpFacade.ProbeOutcome.SEND. A valid flag for a different key is cleared. A later caller waits while a probe is in flight. An interrupt during that wait returns AmwpFacade.ProbeOutcome.SKIP. A later cell does not probe again when the waited probe is valid for the same key. A waited failure returns the last failure text, or grok empty content. The leader effort is the level sent on this probe. sendEffort false leaves reasoning_effort off the probe body.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the target id.
      effort - The effort is the leader probe level.
      sendEffort - The flag is false when reasoning_effort stays off the probe body.
      Returns:
      The return value is send, fail, or skip.

    • clearValid

      void clearValid()
      The clearValid method clears a valid probe after a 401 on a later call. An in-flight probe is left alone.

    • publish

      private void publish(boolean ok, String key, String miss)
      The publish method stores the probe result and wakes waiters. Success sets the valid flag and the key. Success clears the last failure. A failure clears the valid flag and stores the failure text. A null failure text is stored as empty. The probe future is cleared.
      Parameters:
      ok - The flag is true when the probe passed.
      key - The key is the key that was probed.
      miss - The miss is the failure text.

    • missOf

      private String missOf(Throwable err)
      The missOf method turns a probe error into one line. An ExecutionException uses its cause when that cause is present. An Exception cause uses AmwpFacade.garnered(Exception). Any other throwable returns grok empty content.
      Parameters:
      err - The error is the probe failure.
      Returns:
      The return value is that line.
